buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider

2. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Payment online through RTGS / internet banking in Beneficiary name Airports Authority of India Account No. 33964986659 IFSC Code SBIN0001174 Bank Name State Bank of india Branch address Mumbai . Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer along with bid. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Mandatory Documents The following documents are compulsory: 1. Security Clearance (BCAS orders and circulars as applicable to the agency ) 2. Security Programme (BCAS orders and circulars as applicable to the agen cy) 3. ASCO Training Certificate (BCAS orders and circulars as applicable to the agency) 4. Quality Control Programme (BCAS orders and circulars as applicable to th e agency) 5. MSME Certificate 6. GST Certificate 7. EPFO Registration Certificate 8. ESIC Registration Certificate 9. Successful bidder shall have to follow various BCAS orders and circulars a s applicable to the agency. 10. Successful bidder shall have to issue identity cards to all employees emp loyed under this contract.

11.Successful bidder shall have to Submit bank guaranty within 01 month fr om the date of award of work order. (bank guaranty/EPBG acceptable AAI Format) 12.Successful bidder shall have to Submit Every month original invoice with Supporting Documents i.e Wages calculation sheet, GST Under taking, ITR Returns Copy, PF Challan, ESIC Challan, Salary Slip, Payment Conformatio n slip, etc. 13. The successful bidder shall be responsible for all All security-related work and documentation req uired under this contract (including Security Clearance, Security Programme, ASCO Training and ot her BCAS-mandated requirements) shall be in the scope of the bidder. The bidder shall add all extr a applicable charges towards the same to its profit margin and quote its rates accordingly. The Bu yer will not pay any extra charges or additional payment on this bid. 14. Security Programme and ASCO Training After Award of Contract: In case the successful bidder does not possess a valid approved Security Progra mme and/or ASCO Training Certificate at the time of award of the contract, the successful bidder shall be required to: a) Complete the required ASCO Training for its concerned personnel within one (01) month from the date of issuance of the Work Order. b) Apply for approval of the Security Programme with the competent BCAS auth ority and submit the approved Security Programme to the Buyer within one (01) month from the date of issuance of the Work Order. c) Submit a duly signed undertaking to the Buyer at the time of contract award, confirming that the above requirements shall be fulfilled within the stipulated p eriod of one (01) month. Failure to comply: In case the successful bidder fails to complete the ASCO Tr aining and/or obtain and submit the required Security Programme approval with in the stipulated period of one (01) month, the Buyer shall have the right to can cel the award/contract and forfeit the EMD submitted by the bidder, in accordan ce with the applicable tender conditions and rules. .
